display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
START
RepoController.java
Controller receives POST /api/repo/ingest
Then calls IngestionService.ingestRepository(url, userId)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. Start one database transaction
Annotation: @Transactional
If something fails, DB changes can roll back

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. Check GitHub URL format
Uses GITHUB_URL_PATTERN regex
Bad URL stops here

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ERROR PATH
Invalid URL
Throws IllegalArgumentException

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. Extract owner and repo name
Example URL: github.com/openai/codex
owner = openai
repoName = codex

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. Load current user
Calls userRepository.findById(userId)
This proves which user owns the repo

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ERROR PATH
User UUID not found
Ingestion stops

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5. Ask for repo metadata
Needs name, private flag, default branch, size

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6. Build Repo object in memory
status = INGESTING
user = current User object

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7. Save Repo first
Now PostgreSQL creates repo.id UUID
This repo.id is needed for file_nodes.repo_id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8. Ask for full file tree
Uses repo default branch
Fetches files and folders from GitHub

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EMPTY TREE PATH
No tree returned
No FileNode rows are saved

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
9. Convert GitHub tree entries
Each GitHub entry becomes one FileNode object

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
10. Save all FileNode rows
Uses fileNodeRepository.saveAll(nodes)
One DB row per file/folder

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
11. Update file count
repo.fileCount = number of file nodes

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
12. Mark repo ready
repo.status = READY

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
13. Save Repo again
Final state is stored in repos table

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
14. Return saved Repo
Controller sends it back as JSON

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
UserRepository.java
Reads users table by UUID

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RepoRepository.java
First save of Repo
Creates repo row and repo.id UUID

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RepoRepository.java
Second save of Repo
Stores status READY and fileCount

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FileNodeRepository.java
Saves FileNode list
Also used later by analysis pipeline

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
users table
Found by users.id UUID
This is the current logged-in user

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Repo.java
Java entity for repos table
Contains user, url, owner, name, status, defaultBranch, fileCount

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
repos table
First saved row
status = INGESTING
repos.user_id points to users.id

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
repos table
Final saved row
status = READY
file_count is updated

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FileNode.java
Java entity for file_nodes table
Contains repo, path, name, type, depth, sizeBytes, isInScope

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
file_nodes table
Stores many rows
file_nodes.repo_id points to repos.id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GitHubApiClient.java
Method: getRepoInfo(owner, repo)
Uses WebClient to call GitHub

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GitHubApiClient.java
Method: getTree(owner, repo, branch)
Uses WebClient to call GitHub

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
GitHub endpoint
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GitHubRepoResponse.java
DTO for repo metadata JSON
Maps private and default_branch with @JsonProperty

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GitHub endpoint
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/trees/{branch}?recursive=1

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
GitHubTreeResponse.java
DTO for full tree response
Contains List tree

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
GitHubTreeEntry.java
DTO for one file/folder entry
path, type, sha, size

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
entry.path
Example: src/main/App.java

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
name = last part of path
App.java

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
depth = count '/' in path
src/main/App.java has depth 2

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
type rule
GitHub blob becomes FILE
anything else becomes DIRECTORY

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
sizeBytes rule
Use entry.size
If size is null, use 0

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
scope rule
isInScope = true
Means analysis can use it later

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
END
RepoController.java returns JSON to frontend
Frontend can show repo status READY
